body:
# **Credits**
Any Drawings are drawn by: **Jhakla**

 
Character is created by: **Jhakla**


All Plushies/models created by: **Jhakla** or **Tulip**

 
[How I learned to make CIT packs can be found here!](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/jhakla/)

# **[​Needs Optifine!]** 
(1.21.1)
This is a CIT resource/texture pack with all of the plushies I have made so far.
This was made for a Roleplay server on Minecraft, called the TallTalesRP SMP.

More plushies will be uploaded, and (almost) all plushies I make will be added to this CIT pack.
So far, my;
- Pink Sheep Plushie CIT resource pack
- Slabfish Plushie CIT resource pack
- Walking Cane (CIT)
- Bee Plushie CIT
- Shtick(Long Stick) CIT
- Ducks With Hats Plushies [​CIT] 
Are in this!

--------------------------------------------------------

# **-How to work-**
After downloading, go and open Minecraft if you do not have it open.

Then, you would need to go to Settings>Resource Packs.

After that, you should then click on "Open Pack Folder", and take the texture pack and plop it into your texture pack folder.

Then, all you need to do is go into a game, and;

- Rename pink wool and name it "**pinkie**" with an anvil for a standing pink sheep.
- Rename pink wool and name it "**pinkei**" with an anvil for a laying down pink sheep.

or

- Rename green wool block, and name it into "**slabfish**" with an anvil for a normal standing Slabfish.
- Rename green wool block, and name it into "**slab fish**" with an anvil for a normal sitting Slabfish.
- Rename green wool block, and name it into "**slabsfissh**" with an anvil for a "wonky" standing Slabfish.
- Rename green wool block, and name it into "**slabs fissh**" with an anvil for a "wonky" sitting Slabfish.

or

- Rename a stick or any of the wooden tools into "**cane**" with an anvil for a walking cane.

or

- Rename white wool, dark gray wool, black wool, light gray wool, or gray wool into "**Racoonie**" with an anvil for a gray standing Racoon.
- Rename white wool, dark gray wool, black wool, light gray wool, or gray wool into "**Racoonei**" with an anvil for a gray laying Racoon.
- Rename white wool, dark gray wool, black wool, light gray wool, gray wool, red wool, or orange wool into "**Rakoonie**" with an anvil for a red/orange standing Racoon.
- Rename white wool, dark gray wool, black wool, light gray wool, gray wool, red wool, or orange wool into "**Rakoonei**" with an anvil for a red/orange laying Racoon.

or

- Rename a yellow wool, white wool, orange wool, black wool, and name it into "**Bee**" for a yellow-black-yellow bee.
- Rename a yellow wool, white wool, orange wool, black wool, and name it into "**Bie**" for a black-yellow-black bee.
 
or

- Rename a stick, bamboo, or a wooden sword and name it into "**Shtick**" for two sticks taped together! Long!
 
or

- Rename white wool into "**Dukrundo**" for a plain white duck.
- Rename white wool into "**Ducrundo**" for a white duck with a hat.
- Rename white wool into "**Duckrundo**" for a white duck with a hat and some "cool man" glasses!

or
 
- Rename a Iron, Diamond, or Netherite sword it into "**Daggker**".
 
or

- Rename green wool, lime wool, yellow wool, orange wool, black wool, or white wool into "**Plubby**", or "**Plubbius**".

Simple! And none of them are case sensitive and you can add more to the name if you so wish!

--------------------------------------------------

This all should work, if it does not, please comment and I will try it find out what is wrong-!
